sources.entry: Teable | No-code Postgres database with a spreadsheet interface

summary.one_liner: Teable is a self-hostable, no-code platform that puts a spreadsheet-style interface on top of real PostgreSQL, combined with AI chat, app building, and workflow automation.
summary.what_it_does: Teable provides spreadsheet-like tables backed by PostgreSQL, with Grid, Form, Kanban, Gallery, and Calendar views. It supports formulas, filtering, grouping, sorting, aggregation, comments, record history, undo/redo, and real-time collaboration, plus import/export, search, validation, charts, and SQL query. The README describes AI chat over live data, an App Builder where an agent builds and deploys an app to its own URL, and AI workflow automations triggered by record changes, schedules, and webhooks. Self-hosting is offered in a full-featured mode (with AI and App Builder) and a standalone mode (tables, API, automation only). Development setup uses pnpm and a NestJS backend.
use_cases: replace a spreadsheet with a structured database
build internal business apps without coding
track projects in grid, kanban, or calendar views
run AI analysis over your own tables
self-host a team data and collaboration tool
notable: Runs on real PostgreSQL underneath a spreadsheet interface
App Builder deploys agent-built apps to their own URLs as containers
AI sessions run in isolated, on-demand containers
Three deployment tiers: hosted cloud, full-featured self-host, standalone self-host
caveats: AI features and App Builder are not available in the standalone self-host mode
Official image includes paid plans that unlock AI features and enterprise capabilities via a license key
Full-featured self-host is deployed via a separate teableio/teable-deployment repository
